'''Melkor Dinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as chief interrogator. While on Taris, he captured a Republic scientist, [[Mola Haxtor]], and interrogated her about the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] [[Nekghoul]]s in order to use them against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
